visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three female cheerleaders in matching black crop tops labeled "LET'S GO PILOTS" and black mini-skirts stand on a basketball court. The central dancer, with long brown hair and bangs, smiles warmly while performing intricate hand gestures and rhythmic torso movements. Behind her, a vast crowd in orange shirts populates the tiered stadium seating. The arena is bathed in bright, even indoor lighting, emphasizing the vibrant colors of the team uniforms and the court surroundings. (2) The scene shifts to a static medium shot of a black MIPRO branded wireless antenna mounted on a professional tripod. The device is dark and angular, positioned prominently against the backdrop of the arena's colorful and busy spectator section. The indoor stadium lighting reflects off the metallic and plastic surfaces of the broadcasting equipment and the blurred orange-clad crowd behind it. (3) The central cheerleader continues her high-energy routine, utilizing broad arm sweeps and rhythmic body sways in coordination with the music. Her facial expressions remain animated and engaging as she makes eye contact with the camera. In the background, basketball players in jerseys move across the court floor. The stadium environment remains consistent with blurred spectators and electronic signage visible in the distance under bright, clear stadium lights.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy pop music with a fast tempo (approx. 128 BPM) plays continuously from start to finish. A female vocalist sings in Korean with high arousal and positive valence. The musical arrangement is dominated by heavy electronic drum hits, driving synthesizer basslines, and bright, sharp synth melodies. (2) A faint layer of indoor room tone and distant crowd murmurs is present in the mix but is largely masked by the high-volume music track. Occasional percussive electronic sound effects punctuate the transitions between musical phrases. There is no human speech or dialogue present throughout the entire recording, resulting in a focus purely on the musical performance and its rhythmic drive.
